question: ‘Total Recall : My Unbelievably True Life Story’ is an autobiography of:
solution:
The correct answer is__** Arnold Schwarzenegger.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Arnold Schwarzenegger** is a **retired professional bodybuilder** who is also an** American and Austrian actor, businessman, filmmaker, and investor.**
 
• He is also a politician who presided as **California's 38th governor from 2003 to 2011**.
 
• In **2004 and 2007**, Time magazine included Arnold Schwarzenegger in its list of the **100 most influential persons **in the world.
 
• The book** "Total Recall"** by Arnold Schwarzenegger is a candid account of his **illustrious, contentious, and utterly singular life.**
 
• **Other books** by him include:
 
 
• ​The New Encyclopedia of Modern Bodybuilding 
 
• Arnold Education of a Bodybuilder
 
• Arnold's Bodybuilding for Men
 
• Terminator Vault
